elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: For the late-payment circumstance addressed by the clause, Customer is expressly not liable for any liquidated damages, penalty, or similar charge; the only remedy is interest.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount remains in the rendered clause, so the condition is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no early-termination fee or three-month cap.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause does not designate an early-termination fee as the sole liquidated amount; its sole-remedy language applies only to overdue invoices and specifies interest.
